h2. Goals

* Send a confirmation email when an order is placed, wrapped onto a second line
* Keep the *existing* on-screen confirmation
*# first nested, _ordered_
*# second nested with {{code_span}} and a [link|https://example.com/a_b-c]

h2. Design

As agreed with [~jdoe], see !flow diagram.png! and the [spec|^spec.pdf].
Escapes: \*not bold\*, a \{brace}, a \[bracket], a pipe \|, C:&#92;path, \-5 and 3-D, SOME_CONST_NAME, foo{*}bar{*}baz.
Hi! See [https://example.com/x_y] and https://example.com/raw_url-x. Mail [mailto:me@example.com].
